_comment: HQ's GitHub App and the permissions it is registered with. A test holds them to exactly what HQ's code and pipeline ask for; scripts/wire-github-app.py puts its key where the pipeline reads it. Nothing personal lives in this file.

hq.description: HQ's one app. The controller reads each repository and reports delivery; an extension's admission starts the host's composition; the composition reads the extensions' admissions. Each use mints a token for only what it does.
hq.installed_on: the host repository and every extension repository
